notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
The game was updated 2 days ago, but I didn't have enough time to write down patch notes.

[h1]Bug fixes and Testing[/h1]
Every known bugs are fixed.
Testing is also enhanced, I did a bot that plays the game 24/7 and if anything happens I will notice. 
Good news even after a couple days of gaming, there were no performance drop.

[h1]New features[/h1]
Now you can see every buff enemies get in the left-top

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637085/b9823820b0ab9146b46409569b5b2fc8a2be7760.jpg[/img]

Auras of Bendrix and Cobra (on level 3) are now visible.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637085/ea9e638de6f6bfc586c43fdb4877146374596684.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The first update
notes.notes:
[img][/img]More than a week left from the Early Access launch. Thanks for positive curator reviews the game recieved. They motivated me a lot.

The patch affects almost every aspect of the game. Most importantly UI.

[h1]User Interface improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Help section[/b] is improved
[*] [b]Tutorials[/b] are improved
[*] [b]Robot management[/b] is now more friendly
[*] [b]Options menu[/b] now is more friendly
[*] [b]Achievements section[/b] now shows rewards for each achievement
[*] Now [b]Rewards screen[/b] shows rewards you get for achievements
[*] Now you can see achievements info from [b]Pause menu[/b]
[*] [b]Icons[/b] are updated
[*] Minor fixes and improvements
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637085/e7110fa8760854b28e33a455f8123d791529d3b0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Balance changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Fast start and 3 power[/b] upgrades are buffed.
[*] [b]Spider tactics[/b] now gives 1 more damage
[*] [b]Patient spider[/b] now gives 1 more damage
[*] [b]Flying trainer[/b] now gives 15 damage against flyers
[*] Now [b]Leaf[/b] at 3-level stuns the target for 1.2 seconds
[*] [b]Dragonspawn-A1[/b] has 345 HP now.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637085/98121a3d857fb1c9c8a1ed3e10dcf68c4b1f287f.jpg[/img]
[h1]Mechanics changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Procedural generated maps are more accurate now
[*] Chances of getting items in hard mode are increaced
[*] More rewards for infinity mode.(Depends on how long you survive)
[*] The game is optimized even more. Now it will not lag even after 200+ waves.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637085/b388b990cfa7da70011563c423eb8b53037e7217.jpg[/img]
